$Comment: The Headless Horseman's glow as he winds up his dash on foot (Hallows_Eve_Template_Horseman_Foot puts it on him as the one-second wind-up starts): the game's own charge highlight (Saw_Charge_VFX, the yellow sheen its Gobliterator wears before a dash) and the Gobliterator's warning marker on the ground just ahead of him, without that effect's saw sparks. Duration covers the wind-up and the first moments of the dash; Scale and PositionOffset place the marker (Z ahead, Y down from his origin).
